Coram : G.S. SINGHVI*, H.L. GOKHALE, RANJANA PRAKASH DESAI
C Service Law - Co-terminus employees (respondents) - Entitlement of, to continue in service after cessation of engagement of the person with whose engagement their services were made co-terminus - Held: Respondents were engaged were sponsored by the D Chairman of the Pondicherry Khadi and Village Industries Board, a statutory body corporate - They did not come into the service either through the Employment Exchange or through any procedure in which they were required to compete against other eligible candidates -
Decision Date : 12-03-2013 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2323/2013 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
